newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV STARTS $80 MLN CABLE LINK.
newsitem.headline: CANTV STARTS $80 MLN CABLE LINK.

text.p: Venezuelan telephone company CANTV said it will start construction Monday of an $80 million underwater cable link to join eastern Venezuela to the country's national fiber optic network.
CANTV said the cable link would be completed by Oct 15 and would increase the national network's transmission capacity.
CANTV is run by GTE Corp, which holds a 40 percent stake in the company. It holds a monopoly on basic telephone services until November 2000.
